title.en: Correct beginner glosses found by real-user multilingual QA
title.zh: 修正多语言真实用户 QA 发现的初级词义

purpose.en: Turn defects discovered during a live four-language learner round into forward-only, tested vocabulary corrections.
purpose.zh: 把四语言真实学习轮次发现的内容缺陷转化为前向、可验证的词汇修正。

en: Replace unnatural beginner Chinese glosses discovered in Spanish and Italian practice.
Apply the same president-title correction to matching French, Portuguese, and Russian beginner entries.
Preserve all 48,000 published vocabulary rows, phonetics, learner guides, and progress records.
zh: 修正西班牙语和意大利语练习中发现的不自然初级中文释义。
把同类职务名称修正同步应用到法语、葡萄牙语和俄语初级词条。
保留全部 48,000 个已发布词条、音标、助读和用户学习进度。
多语言智慧卡答案选项
管理员 Project 发布报告

en: Add a forward-only database migration for the affected high-frequency beginner entries.
Use concise learner-facing senses for president, really, nobody, and the feminine form of new/news.
Add exact regression assertions so the corrected meanings cannot silently regress.
zh: 为受影响的高频初级词条增加前向数据库迁移。
为“总统/主席”“真的/确实”“没有人”和阴性“新的/消息”提供简洁学习释义。
增加精确回归断言，防止修正后的词义静默退化。

en: A signed-in Chrome learner completed English, Japanese, Spanish, and Italian Course, Play, and Everyday Speaking coverage.
Server-graded daily quizzes displayed 100/100 and persisted learning logs for the tested languages.
Vocabulary catalog and D1 migration suites pass with 48,000 rows and zero foreign-key violations.
zh: 已登录 Chrome 测试学员完成英语、日语、西班牙语和意大利语的课程、边玩边学与生活口语覆盖。
受测语言的服务器每日测验显示 100/100，并保存真实学习日志。
词汇目录与 D1 迁移测试通过：48,000 个词条，外键违规为零。

en: Acoustic pronunciation scoring remains device-dependent; this controlled Chrome round verified microphone recovery and skip paths but did not claim a human voice score.
zh: 声学发音评分仍取决于设备输入；本次受控 Chrome 轮次验证了麦克风恢复与跳过路径，但不宣称获得真人语音分数。

en: This vocabulary-data correction is SmartLingo-only and does not change other portfolio sites.
zh: 本词汇数据修正仅适用于 SmartLingo，不改变其他站点。
